name: Physics-Informed Diffusion Model
name_zh: 物理信息扩散生成模型
summary: Train diffusion-based generators with governing-equation loss terms to promote physical sample consistency.
summary_zh: 在扩散生成训练中加入基于第一性原理的物理残差损失。
core_idea: Augment generative training with equation and inequality residual penalties for generated physical fields.
innovation: Addresses a common gap between visually plausible generative outputs and governing-equation consistency.
limitations: Soft residual losses do not prove exact physical validity.
Differential residual evaluation can increase training cost.

start_here.why: Direct physics-informed diffusion method validated on scientific examples.
start_here.focus: Physical training loss, generated-field residuals and problem scope.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
